title: Cross Shaped Amethyst Clusters
description: Reverts Amethyst Clusters back into their vanilla cross shape for players who use a resource pack that turns Amethyst Clusters into 3D models.
body:
This is a resource pack that turns Amethyst Clusters back into their vanilla cross shape, made for players who use a resource pack that turns Amethyst Clusters into 3D models but prefer the vanilla cross shape.

### Note
If the game says this texture pack is made for an older version of Minecraft, just ignore it, it'll most likely still work.
